{"script":"rm -rf temp_workspace
mkdir -p temp_workspace

# 1-2: recursive listing of all entries under /var
find /var -printf '%y %p\n' > temp_workspace/raw_list.txt 2>/dev/null

# 3: extract only regular files (lines starting with 'f ')
grep '^f ' temp_workspace/raw_list.txt | sed 's/^f //' > temp_workspace/files_only.txt

# 4: canonicalize/normalize paths
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  c=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null) || c=""
  if [ -z "$c" ]; then c="$p"; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$c"
done < temp_workspace/files_only.txt > temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt

# 5: verify each canonical path still exists and is a regular file
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -f "$p" ] && printf '%s\n' "$p"
done < temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt > temp_workspace/verified_files.txt

# prepare raw paths (without the type prefix) for potential comparisons
sed 's/^.[[:space:]]//' temp_workspace/raw_list.txt > temp_workspace/raw_paths.txt

# counts
raw_count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/raw_list.txt | tr -d ' ')
files_count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/files_only.txt | tr -d ' ')
canonical_count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt | tr -d ' ')
verified_count=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/verified_files.txt | tr -d ' ')

# 6: record discrepancies
{
  echo "raw_count: $raw_count"
  echo "files_only_count: $files_count"
  echo "canonical_count: $canonical_count"
  echo "verified_count: $verified_count"
  echo
  echo "Entries in files_only but not in canonical_files:"
  comm -23 <(sort temp_workspace/files_only.txt) <(sort temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt) || true
  echo
  echo "Entries in canonical_files but not in verified_files:"
  comm -23 <(sort temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt) <(sort temp_workspace/verified_files.txt) || true
  echo
  echo "Duplicate canonical paths (will be removed during deduplication):"
  sort temp_workspace/canonical_files.txt | uniq -d || true
} > temp_workspace/discrepancies.log

# 7: sort and deduplicate verified files to produce authoritative inventory
sort -u temp_workspace/verified_files.txt > temp_workspace/var_inventory.txt

# 8: manifest stating ready for counting
echo "Inventory verified and ready for final counting." > temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt

# Output only the final total number (lines in var_inventory)
wc -l < temp_workspace/var_inventory.txt
"}
